what: A point of light floats on the border of a window (card·app screen). At first it sits at a set rest spot (72% down, etc.), and when the cursor comes over the window or within 12px, it slides along the perimeter to the border spot nearest the cursor (10% of the remaining distance per frame, at most 14px). If it must jump more than 18% of the perimeter, it fades out by .06 per frame and fades in at the new spot by .04. Around the light spot, a border-shaped glow (radius = window’s long side × .5), a 2px light ring, a faint tint inside the window and a .5rem glass-rim tint outside all move together, and dust floating within 8.125rem outside the rim sparkles only near the light (30fps, 15fps when idle)

options.side: Rest-spot side — top, right, bottom, left, corner, default bottom
options.dust: If off, no dust canvas is created
options.density: Dust density (140 particles × this value on a 1440×900 panel), default 2.6
options.--fx-light-glow · --fx-light-mid · --fx-: Glow, outline and center color (css), default taken from the accent color
options.--fx-g · --fx-gap: Width the blur and dust panel extends out of the window, glass rim width (css), defaults 8.125rem · .5rem
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Window the light circles around the border (first child if none). Corners read the window’s border-radius

use: …
note: Light rings, glow and dust are created inside the element on attach and removed on detach. On touch devices and with reduced motion, they stay lit and still at the rest position. The original groups several windows and moves the light to the window nearest the cursor, but the part runs each window separately

from.where: index.html .f-plight (invoice app · step window · checkout screen · matching window · code window) — original ProductLight: resting position rest {side, at}, near 12px, skip 18%, speed 1-.9^dt·14px, off .06·on .04, blur size × .5, light ring long = size × .32
